At the time, we did not have anything similar or intended to keep working with that tech stack. We've been building production-ready Go applications for a long time, so building a similar project with Golang as its core was natural. Additionally, as Go has taken a huge role in many other vital projects such as Kubernetes and Docker, and we've been able to use the pREST project in many different companies with success over the years, it has shown to be an excellent decision. ## 1-Click Deploy ### Heroku Deploy to Heroku and instantly get a realtime RESTFul API backed by Heroku Postgres: [![Deploy to Heroku](https://www.herokucdn.com/deploy/button.svg)](https://heroku.com/deploy?template=https://github.com/prest/prest-heroku) ## Documentation Visit https://docs.prestd.com/
